headline: Kanye West Announces Russia Concerts, Months After Western Europe Cancellations
context: Two St. Petersburg concerts by the rapper formerly known as Kanye West could become the first performances by a major Western act in Russia since the country invaded Ukraine.

sources.name: The New York Times
